feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 5 (wheel_radius 0.035 m, mass 0.6 kg, track 0.12 m) is the best state so far at 51.01, with s-bend progress 0.155, slalom 0.107 and max_error 0.061 to 0.066. Iteration 6 showed that mass 0.5 kg lowers progress (s-bend 0.155 to 0.149) and raises max_error (0.065 to 0.068), so mass stays at 0.6 kg. Iteration 7 showed that track 0.14 m lowers progress (s-bend 0.145, slalom 0.100), which means 0.12 m is the track the robot is tuned to. Iterations 0, 1 and 4 showed that controller gain changes barely move max_error, so the controller is not the main limit at this speed. I kept the iteration 5 controller unchanged, so the wheel_radius step is tested alone. Interpret the next race as follows. If progress rises above 0.155 on the s-bend and above 0.107 on the slalom, with max_error at or below 0.069 on every track, speed is still helping. Keep wheel_radius 0.04 m and do not change the track or mass. If progress is flat, or max_error rises above 0.069, speed has reached its useful limit at this controller setting. Return wheel_radius to 0.035 m and let the Integrator adjust the controller gains.
